description: Phase B-4 c_αα probe (EXPLORATORY — NEGATIVE result). Tests whether the substrate-canonical Markov-trace value m_e·|tr_M(T_w(7²_1), q_0)| could replace the literature c_αα = m_e·Vol(7²_1) ≈ 2.43 MeV in alpha_cluster_recursion.py. Mirrors the proton-mass case (|tr_M(𝓑₃)| << m_p) — bare |tr_M| is not the substrate-pure binding-scale derivation; VolDensity chain (Vol/ℏ_q² × linking_weight) is. This probe does NOT propose changing alpha_cluster_recursion.py.
